findings.description: The constructor accepts any prices dictionary without validating that all prices are non-negative integers, which violates the contract that Catalog must hold non-negative integer prices.
findings.evidence: Catalog({'a': -10}) creates an instance that stores a negative price; subsequent price('a') returns -10, contradicting "holds non-negative integer prices".

review.summary: Constructor does not enforce non-negative initial prices, violating the contract that Catalog must hold non-negative integer prices.
